title: Axe PolarFFA
description: Public Release for Axe FFA Plugin used on DementedPolars Minecraft Server
body:
This custom-built Minecraft plugin powers the Axe Free-For-All (FFA) experience on the DementedPolars server (IP: dementedpolars.net). Designed for smooth performance and player engagement, the plugin includes the following features:

🔹 /stats Command – Instantly view your FFA statistics including kills, deaths, and K/D ratio (being added in later updates).

🔹 Live Stats Scoreboard – Stay updated in real-time with an on-screen scoreboard showing your current stats.

🔹 /fight Command – Teleport directly to the Fight Arena spawn and jump straight into the action.

🔹 /spawn Command – Return to the main spawn area whenever needed.

🔹 Configurable Database Support – Seamless integration with your database of choice for saving and retrieving player stats.

🔹 /heal Command for player to heal themselves. This requires players to have the permission "polarffa.heal"

🔹 Configurable Header & Footer for Scoreboard containing Kills & Deaths

🔹 Being Added Soon:
- Kill-Death (K/D) Ratio to ScoreBoard
      
- Kills Leaderboard


Whether you're managing a competitive server or running community events, this plugin adds a clean, responsive, and customizable FFA system tailored for axe combat.
